analysis: The supplied units are BASE-side excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (lines 1713-2433+). The PR's changed ranges are at other lines (head 3, 1092-1106, 1139-1156, 1217). The patch excerpt is truncated. The visible patch lines only bump the 'Last updated' date and add documentation of a sandbox-setup disk shortfall note (SandboxSizingPlan.freeSpaceNote). That note explains df/Avail, purgeable space and an N GB more figure, and appears to be informational only. The change is documentation-only: it adds no code, no network, auth, attestation, encryption or data-handling behaviour. It therefore changes no controls under TB-011, TB-012 or TB-013, the add-on hold socket, or the T-041 prefix-cache posture. The base text I reviewed still describes the pre-existing security-relevant behaviour: the SSD prefix-cache env switches, the add-on runtime paths (~/.darkbloom/runtime with 0700/0600 modes), token paths, the fan helper and the logout/unenroll flows. I saw nothing in it that is contradicted by the diff, and no threat-model assumption is invalidated. Remaining uncertainty: the unreviewed head-side hunks at 1139-1156 and 1217 were not visible in these units, so any security-relevant wording there (for example an altered sandbox setup flow or installer trust description, T-061) is unverified. I cannot judge whether the documentation matches the implementation, because the SandboxSizingPlan source was not supplied. No findings qualify on the evidence provided.
